name: NYC 311 Service Requests from 2020 to Present
publisher: City of New York (NYC Open Data)
version_note: Rolling dataset, updated by the publisher (Socrata id erm2-nwe9). Pin every pull by recording the query, retrieval timestamp and file sha256 (done automatically in RETRIEVAL.json). A web-search result listed the same id under the title '311 Service Requests from 2010 to Present': the portal title/coverage may have changed, so confirm the title and date range at download time.

data_access.method: Socrata SODA API (JSON/CSV) or bulk CSV export
data_access.app_token: optional; supply via env SOCRATA_APP_TOKEN, never commit

license.name: NYC Open Data Terms of Use

evidence.note: Summary states the dataset is published under the NYC Open Data Terms of Use ('free to use and redistribute; no warranty'). Not read from the official terms.
Official page could not be fetched: the authoring sandbox's network egress proxy blocks this host.

license.attribution: Source: City of New York, NYC Open Data — 311 Service Requests (dataset erm2-nwe9). Cite retrieval date. Exact attribution wording must be taken from the Terms of Use.
notes: Read the Terms of Use yourself before use. Even if redistribution is permitted, this repository does not redistribute the data.
The terms URL on this card was recalled from memory and not verified.

subset_used: To be selected by the team (suggest: a bounded date window and complaint types that map to taxonomy v1; see mappings/nyc311_to_civic.v1.json and run `cli profile` first).
restrictions: Terms of Use not yet read at the primary source.
Do not attempt to re-identify requesters; the public file is not designed for individual-level analysis.
Do not commit raw or prepared rows.

supports.how: Realistic spatio-temporal request data to validate deterministic hotspot / recurrence / baseline-comparison logic and analytics SQL (facts come from SQL, not models).
caveats: Categories are NYC's, mapped to ours via an explicit draft mapping; use the mapped subset only.

supports.how: Closed-date minus created-date distributions per complaint type to sanity-check SLA hours and case-age scoring ranges.
caveats: Provides resolution-time priors only; it does NOT provide severity or priority ground truth.

supports.how: Distributional study of how requests cluster in space/time (candidate-gate radius and window).
caveats: No duplicate ground-truth label is expected in this dataset: it cannot score duplicate-detection accuracy.

supports.how: Realistically distributed rows to seed a demo database for grounded-copilot demonstrations.
caveats: Demo realism only, not a model evaluation. Must be labelled as NYC real public data.

does_not_support.why: Public columns hold agency category/descriptor fields, not citizen narrative text (to be confirmed with `cli profile` on the real file). Classifying category text back into the category it came from is label leakage.

known_limitations: City-specific agencies and categories (NYC, not an Indian municipality).
Timestamps are source-local, timezone not stated.
privacy_notes: Addresses/coordinates may be present. Use coordinates only; drop address columns during preparation (the adapter never reads them).
expected_schema_notes: Expected (not verified) columns: unique_key, created_date, closed_date, agency, agency_name, complaint_type, descriptor, status, latitude, longitude, borough. The adapter resolves columns by alias and fails loudly with the real header list.
role_summary: Optional external / cross-city generalisation source (not Indian).
